page.layout: One page of running text in one column; the text is set in a single block. Right margin holds a few short cut-off lines of text that run into the outer edge (treated as the text's line ends, not notes). No headings, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: pelli uice,panos auferunt.Blattę alis & pe-dibus detractis ad idem ualent. Paulus am-moniacum ex melle impositū probat.Pro-polis (eodem tefte) duros tumores appe-rit. Ad eadem conferunt radix cucumeris syluestris cum therebinthina,radix cappa-ris recens,nitrum cum fermeto. Hastenus de alarum & inguinum tumoribus ex ue-terum sententia. Superest ut eadem serie ad carbunculi pestiferi curā nos accingamus. Pustulas, quas nonnulli papulas ardentes nominant,& futuros carbunculos indicat grauis somnus,nonunquam totius corpo-ris horror,ac habitus sanguineus. Hi autē tumores in omni fere corporis parte ena-sci solent, cum ardente rubore, duri, & cū pustulis in superficie eminentibus, quæ ut plurimum,nigræ apparent, interdum sub-liuidæ,aut pallidæ, in quibus sanies cerni-tur. Cæterum color infra niger est, ipsum corpus aridum ac durum,inflammatū,& circa quod quasi crusta quędam est.Hic tu-mor quasi quibusdam radicibus subtractis interdum celerius serpit,interdū tardius,ꝑ materiæ uenenatæ potentia: supra quoq; procedens albescit:deinde liuidum fit, cir-cumq; exiguæ pustulæ innascuntur:& si cit-ca os.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s per the rules; the page as printed uses long s throughout, so the transcription above normalises it to s. Fragment "ca os." at the foot continues from the last line and is kept as a fragment. Line-end hyphens: "appe-rit" (appe-rit), "ena-sci" and similar are joined only where the printed hyphen is visible. Possible misreadings: "Blattę" (Blatte or Blattę), "ꝑ" at the start of the line "materiæ" (printed as a p-with-stroke), "nitrum" is read as printed; "cura" in "curā" has a macron as printed. Line "cum ardente rubore, duri, & cū" is read as printed; the ampersand near "duri" is a clear &. Right-edge cut-off words on several lines are partly lost to the page edge and are marked as read.
